PRIVACY & READER PROTECTION

Privacy Policy & Reader Terms

Pinoy Ball respects reader privacy and collects minimal technical data necessary to deliver fast, accessible NBA coverage.

1. Information We Collect

Public readers can browse all Pinoy Ball NBA predictions, schedules, and archive pages without creating an account or submitting personal information. Standard web server logs record anonymized request metadata (such as browser user-agent, requested page path, and region) strictly for security, uptime monitoring, and caching performance.

2. Cookies & Third-Party Requests

Public pages on Pinoy Ball do not set advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. On the NBA Schedule page, your browser may request live public scoreboard data from ESPN’s public NBA endpoint and load Google Fonts stylesheets.

3. Philippine Data Privacy Notice

If you email our editorial desk voluntarily at editorial@pinoyball.com, your email address and message are used solely to respond to your inquiry in accordance with Republic Act No. 10173 (Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012) and are never sold or shared with third parties.

4. Informational Disclaimer

All NBA predictions and matchup analyses on Pinoy Ball represent independent editorial opinions for informational and entertainment purposes only. Pinoy Ball does not accept wagers or facilitate gambling.

PINOY BALL Independent thinking. Basketball first.
